novel_features.name: Multi-location roster
novel_features.description: One table summarizing operational health metrics (new leads, unread conversations, unpaid invoices, stale opportunities) across every sub-account in one row each.
novel_features.rationale: Requires joins across contacts, conversations, messages, invoices, and opportunities keyed by location_id — a per-call MCP can't do it.
novel_features.why_it_matters: When a user asks 'how are all my locations doing this morning', this is the one command that answers it without 50 round-trips.

novel_features.name: Cross-location unread triage
novel_features.description: List inbound conversations that have no outbound reply, optionally filtered by location, recency, and assignee.
novel_features.rationale: Joins messages + conversations and applies a NOT EXISTS subquery — a single API call can't express it across locations.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Answers 'what conversation actually needs me right now' without paging through 10 inbox tabs.

novel_features.name: Stale opportunities with activity check
novel_features.description: Find pipeline opportunities with no stage change AND no message/note activity in N days, grouped by stage.
novel_features.rationale: LEFT JOIN against messages and notes by contact_id, scoped to a pipeline — no MCP today does this join.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Replaces the manual Tuesday-morning kanban hunt for 'who's stuck and forgotten'.

novel_features.name: Pipeline stage velocity
novel_features.description: Mean/p50/p90 time-in-stage per pipeline stage, plus count entered/exited and conversion percentage.
novel_features.rationale: Requires a stage-history table populated via incremental sync polling — pure API has no historical view.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Replaces a $300/mo Airtable+Zapier mirror with a one-line shell command.

novel_features.name: SLA breach detector
novel_features.description: Conversations across all locations where the last inbound message has no outbound reply within a threshold, optionally restricted to business hours.
novel_features.rationale: Joins conversations + messages + locations.business_hours — competing MCPs cannot do this join.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Catches SLA breaches in real time instead of after the client complains.

novel_features.name: Contact dedup with merge
novel_features.description: Find duplicate contacts by phone or email, output merge candidates, optionally apply via the contacts merge endpoint.
novel_features.rationale: GROUP BY over normalized phone/email on local contacts — only feasible after a sync, no native dedup endpoint.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Cleans up the post-migration mess that plagues every reseller migration.

novel_features.name: Bulk tag from search with dry-run
novel_features.description: Apply or remove a tag across the results of a contact search, with dry-run preview and rate-limit-aware progress.
novel_features.rationale: Composes the canonical contact search with per-contact tag updates while respecting the documented 100/10s rate limit.
novel_features.why_it_matters: One-line 'retag this campaign cohort' instead of 500 manual UI clicks.

novel_features.name: Migration reconcile
novel_features.description: Diff a source CSV against the synced local contact set on a key column, output created/updated/missing/extra rows.
novel_features.rationale: Pure local LEFT JOIN — only meaningful after a sync, doesn't fit any single API call.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Closes the loop on every reseller migration so nothing falls through the cracks.

novel_features.name: Agent context delta
novel_features.description: Structured JSON description of every command, flag, and auth env var so agents can introspect the live CLI without parsing --help or reading source.
novel_features.rationale: Reflects the cobra command tree at runtime via --help walks; no API call needed, no store access required, no per-invocation watermark.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Lets an agent discover what actions are available without scraping help text — the schema_version field signals breaking shape changes.

narrative.headline: Every HighLevel feature, plus offline state, multi-location rollups, SLA detection, and pipeline velocity that no MCP server can answer.
narrative.value_prop: gohighlevel-pp-cli mirrors all 409 HighLevel REST endpoints as typed Cobra commands and MCP tools, then layers a local SQLite store on top so cross-location triage (`roster`, `unread`, `sla-breach`), pipeline analytics (`velocity`, `stale-opps`), and bulk operations with `--dry-run` (`bulk-tag`, `dedup`, `reconcile`) become one-line shell commands instead of 50 tab-opens.
narrative.auth_narrative: HighLevel uses OAuth 2.0 Bearer tokens or Private Integration Tokens (PITs). PITs are the simplest path: create one in Settings → Private Integrations, then `export HIGHLEVEL_TOKEN=<pit>`. Every request also requires a `Version: 2021-07-28` header — the CLI sets it automatically.

quickstart.comment: Set up auth — PITs avoid the OAuth dance entirely
Discover the locations your token can reach
Pull contacts, conversations, opportunities, invoices into local SQLite
Cross-location operational health in one row per sub-account

troubleshoots.fix: Token works but `Version` header is missing — upgrade the CLI; this is set automatically in every release.
Token may be agency-scoped; commands targeting locations need a Location-scoped PIT or an OAuth token with the right scope.
Use `--dry-run` first; bulk commands self-throttle to the 100/10s budget but parallel CLIs share none of that state.
Run `sync --resource opportunities,messages,notes` first — stale detection joins against the local store.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI when you need real cross-location analytics, scriptable bulk ops, or agent-native triage against HighLevel. The MCP servers in the ecosystem are excellent for per-call lookups inside Claude Desktop. This CLI is for the Monday-standup roster, the Tuesday pipeline review, the migration reconcile, and any agent that needs 'what changed since I last looked.'
